note: Marker-ball detector settings. PREREG A.6 values ("ball radius window", "ball detector"; SPEC section 10) are frozen and unchanged since v1. Version 2 (2026-10-31, B7) changes two implementation settings after B7 dev run 1 (ep2, GT-free, informed; DEVIATIONS 82): the robust fit uses the points within r_cl + 3 sigma of the vote cluster centre (v1: 2 r_cl, which let the fit grow into the host surface), and the second pass window is intersected with the A.6 window (v1 allowed 13.2 mm). markers.FROZEN must equal "settings" (tests/test_markers.py Frozen).
